children.value: > Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.

> > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried is accused of using “billions of dollars in misappropriated FTX customer deposits” to help buy more than $200 million of real estate for himself, make billions of dollars of investments for his own interest, and repay Alameda’s lenders

> > > Fact From Story: The indictment also says that there were special features in FTX’s code that “permitted Alameda to spend and withdraw unlimited amounts of money from FTX,” which were created at Bankman-Fried’s direction.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Creating special features in code to allow unlimited withdrawals suggests intentional manipulation and potential fraud.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” diverting customers’ funds to Alameda.

> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried is accused of using “billions of dollars in misappropriated FTX customer deposits” to help buy more than $200 million of real estate for himself, make billions of dollars of investments for his own interest, and repay Alameda’s lenders.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Using customer deposits for personal expenses, investments, and repaying debts constitutes a misuse of funds and can be considered wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Misappropriating customer funds and using them for personal gain are elements of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Wire fraud and conspiracy are serious criminal charges.
